messages.author: f1ce6d55520cb81f
messages.subject: ‘semPaths’ for R version 3.1.1
parts:
Is the ‘semPaths’ available for R version 3.1.1? 

What other functions can be used to plot SEM paths?

When I instal semPaths I get this message:

Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘semPaths’ is not available (for R version 3.1.1)

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: ‘semPaths’ for R version 3.1.1
parts:
The package name is "semPlot" semPaths is the function name to get path diagrams. 

So install.packages("semPlot") should  work with R 3.1.1

Alex
